title: The Voices Beside the Still Waters
intro: Picture a community named not for a city or a ruler, but for the still water around which life gathered. Only a few verses remember this community, always listed among those who rejected guidance. Listen as they speak from obscurity.
clues: We are a community named in the Quran, yet our full story remains veiled in mystery.
We are always mentioned alongside those who denied, like the people of Ad and Thamud.
We are called the Companions of Ar-Rass, the Well to which our life was tied.
We denied the messenger who was sent to us with clear guidance.
We are counted among those who rejected all the messengers sent by Allah.
We faced the threat fulfilled against every denier before us, destruction for our rejection.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Built a lofty tower to reach the heavens
Denied the messenger sent to us
Worshipped the golden calf in the absence of Musa
Plotted to kill Yusuf out of envy
trial.answer: Denied the messenger sent to us

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Swallowed by the earth for pride in treasure
Saved by the Ark from the flood
Made to sleep for centuries in a cave
Granted control of wind and jinn

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
